title: Understanding Dimension Set Id in AL for Business Central
summary: Dimension Set ID is a Business Central concept that deduplicates dimension combinations to reduce data storage. The post explains why dimensions are superior to segment-based accounting and provides AL code to retrieve or create a Dimension Set ID by building temporary dimension entries and passing them to the DimensionManagement codeunit.
key_points: Business Central uses dimensions (metadata-driven) instead of segment-based accounting (hard-coded GL account segments) for flexible account classification
Dimension Set ID deduplicates dimension combinations; matching combinations return the same ID rather than creating duplicates
AL code must create temporary Dimension Set Entry records, populate them with dimension codes and values, then pass them to DimensionManagement.GetDimensionSetID()
Two global dimensions available everywhere; unlimited additional dimensions can be added without modifying the chart of accounts

quotes.text: Every time you assign a series of dimensions to a record the Dimension Set table is checked to see if that unique combination exists.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core mechanism of how Dimension Set ID prevents data duplication by finding or creating matching dimension combinations
